scope: Orthodox chess (with notes for Chess960-aware castling handling)

recommended_validity_levels.meaning: State was generated from the standard initial position by your own legal move engine or a fully trusted replay pipeline.
recommended_validity_levels.recommended_use: Internal game play, search, perft, random walks.

recommended_validity_levels.meaning: State passes structural, local-legality, and history-field validation under the selected I/O policy.
recommended_validity_levels.recommended_use: Imported positions that are safe to analyze locally, but not necessarily guaranteed reachable.

recommended_validity_levels.meaning: Imported state passed extra retrograde-style heuristics in addition to BASIC_VALID.
recommended_validity_levels.recommended_use: Stricter import workflows where obvious unreachable positions should be rejected.

recommended_validity_levels.meaning: State is BASIC_VALID but triggered one or more reachability heuristics.
recommended_validity_levels.recommended_use: Warn, quarantine, or reject depending on product goals.

recommended_validity_levels.meaning: State violates at least one fatal or strict invariant.

spec_fen.description: Preserve the EP target square after any double pawn push exactly as defined by the original FEN specification, even when no legal EP capture exists.

strict_captureable.description: Keep an EP square only when at least one legal EP capture exists and the capture is king-safe.

historical_rights.description: Castling rights encode history (king/rook not previously moved), not current immediate legal castlability.
separate_checks_required: transit and destination squares not attacked

import_policy_recommendation.summary: Do not label every syntactically acceptable FEN as 'legal'. Distinguish BASIC_VALID from reachable legality.
recommended_pipeline: optionally canonicalize to strict internal policy
